notes.title: Update on health issues and release date
notes.content:
For the past month or two, I have been undergoing depression.

While the depression is not suicidal, it is still fairly severe, and unfortunately, somewhat unpredictable.

There are some days wherein I get extreme panic attacks and start spontaneously crying and shaking. Sometimes, I cannot pinpoint the reason.

Due to my psychosomatism, I experience physical pain from my mental issues as well, mostly in my gut and sometimes in my head.

This makes working consistently on the game extremely tough, especially since I cannot predict when I'll suffer from these attacks.

As a result, I've decided to set the release date of SKULL CHAINZ to "2022" instead of "January 25th, 2022". 

I still try to work on the game everyday - this change in release date is mainly to relieve some external tension.

Thank you for your understanding, and I apologize to everyone who is excited for the game.

- Chaoclypse

notes.title: Update to the SKULL CHAINZ Demo!
notes.content:
Update to the SKULL CHAINZ demo! In addition to tweaks and fixes, the game is now less punishing. 

You now have an extra life - obtaining tarot card upgrades will also heal your skull to full!
